description: This file defines the DataSetApiController class, which handles API requests related to data sets, including retrieving paginated and filtered lists of data sets via the dataSetsAction method.

classes.name: DataSetApiController
classes.description: Controller class handling API endpoints for data set retrieval, extending AbstractApiController.

methods.name: dataSetsAction
methods.description: Handles the retrieval of data sets with optional filtering by SDG and footprint, supports pagination, and returns the result as a JSON response.
